creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Sources/MusterMac/KeyTranslation.swift:63 treats a key's characters as control only when `scalar.value < 0x20`, and SurfaceKeys.swift has `first >= 0x20` at :114 and `< 0x20` at :132. Neither covers DEL (0x7F). Upstream's Swift had the same check and fixed it in f4309055f (#13871), whose test expects alt+backspace to encode `\x1b[127;3u` in kitty mode with no text attached. Given text, the encoder counts Option as spent.

Inferred from that fix, not tested in a pane. This is Muster's port, so the pin move will not fix it. Add the case to the key tests and extend both checks.
title: Option+Backspace may send a kitty-mode program the wrong keys: 0x7F is treated as text
